title: Replacing the GitHub runner: ParlayAPI is not answering
body: ParlayAPI failed 5 checks in a row (refused: Could not read this key's account (no answer, or the key is not accepted).) and the scans are not getting data from it. The engine restarted its connection and now ends this job after the scan it is on so a new runner (a new address) starts: 1 of 3. After 3 it will switch ParlayAPI off and tell you.
